# SOP Audit & Build Plan for The Forge

**Gaps — no SOP yet**

- **Member Onboarding** – no documented first-touch-to-first-class sequence (induction, paperwork, PAR-Q, studio tour, first class experience, goal-setting)
- **Member Checklins & Retention** – no proactive check-in cadence for at-risk members, win-back triggers, or retention milestone framework
- **Cancellation & Churn** – no offboarding protocol; missing exit interview, pause vs. cancel decision tree, re-engagement offers
- **Coaching Development Roadmap** – no career progression, skill certification, or performance review cycle for coaches
- **Class Quality Audit** – no standards for class delivery, coach consistency, or member feedback loop
- **Weekly Key Coach Tasks** – no documented weekly/monthly coaching KPIs or accountability checkpoints
- **Member Data Privacy & GDPR** – critical gap; no data handling, consent, retention, or breach protocol
- **Referral Programme** – no referrer/referee mechanics, incentive structure, or tracking process
- **Order Supplies & Sundries** – no inventory, reorder points, vendor management, or budget ownership
- **Complaints & Incident Reporting** – no formal escalation, documentation, or resolution SOP for member/staff issues

**Needs updating**

- **Clients (26/36 SOPs)** – likely missing depth in: member feedback loops, NPS/satisfaction measurement, pause/freeze mechanics (you have an SOP but not tied to retention strategy), goal-tracking accountability
- **Coaches (20/23 SOPs)** – missing link between weekly tasks, performance review, and development plan; no coaching standards audit tied to class quality
- **Marketing (5/5 complete)** – verify these include referral + retention campaigns

# Service Menu Build for The Forge

**Create two separate docs immediately — they solve different problems:**

• **Coach-facing menu** (internal): List every service tier with profit margins, time allocation, and upsell triggers. Example: "1-to-1 PT £45/session (60min) → upsell to 4-week block at £160 (saves member £20, locks revenue)." Coaches need to see what they're selling and why it matters to their pocket.

• **Member-facing menu** (visual, simple): Strip jargon. Use outcome language, not features. Instead of "strength conditioning program," say "Build lean muscle in 8 weeks — £X/month." Price transparently. Include what's *included* in membership (group classes, app access, etc.) so price anchoring works.

**Pricing strategy decision first** — this drives everything:
- Audit what you're currently charging informally. You likely have pricing scattered across conversations and Instagram.
- Benchmark 3-5 Belfast gyms' pricing to identify your position (premium women-only positioning should justify 15-25% above standard gyms).
- Set prices for: monthly membership, drop-in class, 1-to-1 PT, packages (4, 8, 12 sessions).

**Launch this Friday** — don't overthink it:
- Post the member menu on your website and in-gym (physical + digital). This kills price objections immediately.
- Brief coaches verbally on the coach version at next team meeting. Spend 10 minutes on *why* each upsell exists.

What pricing assumptions are you working with right now?
